race.comment: JUST AWESOME (4) is a progressive gelding who has been well placed to win his last 2 starts on the bounce at Newcastle, and again he looks to be the one to beat with a 3kg claim in a tougher field. He steps up from 900m to 1100m, but has won over this trip in the past, and the hat-trick beckons. ACTION KING (5) has good form in the country, and he is also very competitive at this level. He carries 2kg less for this, and has winning form over this trip, winning twice in the past. With the right run early, he can have a say in the outcome of this race. ROYAL COMMODORE (3) improved second up in a better field at Eagle Farm nearly 3 weeks ago, finishing not far off the placings on heavy ground. If he strikes a wet track here, then he would not be a shock winner. HEZDARNHOTTOO (1) is a lightly tried 5YO gelding with plenty of talent. He resumes at an easier level, and has not missed a placing fresh up in the past. A recent trial win suggests he is ready to rumble.
